# `m.stocks.filings.institutional_holdings`

```python
m.stocks.filings.institutional_holdings(*, filer_cik=None, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

## Arguments

What each argument does for this dataset, and the rule it follows for every dataset that takes it.

| Argument | For this dataset | For every dataset |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `filer_cik` | The filing manager's SEC CIK, as text with its leading zeros, such as `"0001067983"`, or a sequence of them; None, the default, for every filer. |  |
| `start` | The first filing date. | The first day or moment of the range. A date (text such as `"2025-06-02"`, a Python `date`, or a Deephaven `LocalDate`) means the day in the market's time zone: New York for stocks, options, and indices; UTC for forex and crypto; for futures, the trading session that ends that day. An instant is an exact time: a Python `datetime` with a time zone, a `pandas.Timestamp`, a `numpy.datetime64`, a Deephaven `Instant` or `ZonedDateTime`, or Deephaven time text such as `"2025-06-02T09:30 ET"`. Give `start` and `end` as two dates or two instants. A `datetime` without a time zone raises `ValueError`, and a calendar-date field, such as an ex-dividend date, takes dates only. |
| `end` | The last filing date. | The last day, or the moment the range stops, in the same form as `start`. A date includes its whole day, so `start="2025-06-02", end="2025-06-02"` reads all of June 2; an instant is excluded. Leave it out to read through now; a list dataset then sends Massive no end, so it also returns records still to come, such as dividends announced but not yet paid. |
| `sort` | The field to sort by, such as `"filing_date"`. | The field to order the rows by, named as Massive names it, such as `"ex_dividend_date"`. Where the endpoint allows, name several, separated by commas, each with an optional `.asc` or `.desc`: `"ticker,ex_dividend_date.desc"`. This page lists the values the dataset takes. |
| `order` | The direction of `sort`. | The direction of `sort`: `dm.Order.ASC` or `dm.Order.DESC`. |
| `limit` | The most rows to return, in total. | The most rows Massive returns for the whole request, across every symbol you name, kept in Massive's order: ask for newest first (`order=dm.Order.DESC`) to keep the latest. A symbol that comes first can use up the whole limit, so leave `limit` out when you need every row of each symbol. A `fetch()` that follows a table of symbols applies it to each symbol's request, and this dataset's own line says where else it applies to each symbol. |
| `filters` | Further endpoint parameters. | Any other parameter Massive documents for this dataset, as a mapping from the parameter's name to its value, with each dot in the name written as `_`: Massive's `strike_price.gte` is `strike_price_gte`. This page lists the keys the dataset takes. A key it doesn't take, or one that has its own argument, such as `start`, raises `ValueError` naming the keys it does take. A date or time value takes ISO 8601 text, or any value `start` takes. |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AccessionNumber` | String | Unique SEC accession number for the filing (e.g., '0000950123-24-011775'). | REST |
| `Cusip` | String | The CUSIP identifier for the held security. | REST |
| `FileNumber` | String | The 13F-specific file number assigned to the filer. | REST |
| `FilerCik` | String | SEC Central Index Key (10 digits, zero-padded) of the filing entity. | REST |
| `FilingDate` | String | Date when the filing was submitted to the SEC (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD). | REST |
| `FilingUrl` | String | Direct URL to the filing on the SEC EDGAR website. | REST |
| `FilmNumber` | String | SEC EDGAR film number for the filing. | REST |
| `FormType` | String | SEC form type (e.g., '13F-HR' for holdings report, '13F-HR/A' for amended report). | REST |
| `InvestmentDiscretion` | String | Type of investment discretion. Possible values: SOLE, SHARED, DFND (defined). | REST |
| `IssuerName` | String | Name of the company whose securities are held. | REST |
| `MarketValue` | long | Market value of the holding in USD. | REST |
| `OtherManagers` | String[] | List of names of other manager(s) sharing investment discretion over the reported holdings, if applicable. | REST |
| `Period` | String | The quarter end date that the filing covers (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD). | REST |
| `PutCall` | String | Indicates if the holding is a put or call option. Possible values: PUT, CALL, or empty for common stock. | REST |
| `SharesOrPrincipalAmount` | long | Number of shares or principal amount held. | REST |
| `SharesOrPrincipalType` | String | Type of amount reported. Possible values: SH (shares), PRN (principal amount). | REST |
| `TitleOfClass` | String | Description of the class of securities held (e.g., 'COM', 'CL A'). | REST |
| `VotingAuthorityNone` | long | Number of shares with no voting authority. | REST |
| `VotingAuthorityShared` | long | Number of shares with shared voting authority. | REST |
| `VotingAuthoritySole` | long | Number of shares with sole voting authority. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |
